thread:
maria: Quick post of the clustering + fallback spotcheck for compact-embed-v3-lite on multilingual-eval. Dumping the thread.
arthur: can you give a one-liner summary? TL;DR numbers
maria: TL;DR: fp16 baseline good. int8 quant shows ~1.9% absolute drop at recall@1 (short queries most affected). recall@5 ~0.9% down. silhouette drops by ~0.06. anchor fallback recovers most but has a few cost tradeoffs.
jen: per-lang split?
maria: per-lang short-query recall@1 (fp16 -> int8): en 0.88 -> 0.85, es 0.83 -> 0.80, pt 0.81 -> 0.78, ru 0.79 -> 0.78. Notable: en/es/pt cluster leakage for queries <20 tokens.
maria: quick table:
```
metric | fp16 | int8
recall@1 | 0.862 | 0.843
recall@5 | 0.946 | 0.937
recall@10 | 0.967 | 0.961
silhouette(k=60) | 0.428 | 0.368
```
kai: did you try different batch sizes or seeding? could be microbatch order/randomness
maria: ran seed=42 across batch_size 8/64/256. variation <0.15% so not the cause. quantization noise is consistent.
arthur: what about anchors? we should fallback to fp16 for low-confidence cases, yes?
maria: instrumented centroid-distance variance + top2 ratio. With centroid threshold >0.72 fallback rate 3.9% and recall@1 -> 0.859 (near fp16). Cost estimate +1.9% token/CPU cost due to fallbacks.
jen: any cases where fallback didn't help?
maria: 12 examples in sample-fails where both fp16 and int8 miss semantic match (paraphrase coverage issue). Logged in sample-fail-cases.json link in artifacts.
kai: HNSW sensitivity? quant shifts can break neighbor graphs
maria: HNSW ef_search=64: fp16 recall@10 0.943 vs int8 0.938. Bumped ef_search to 128 -> int8 recall@10 0.942 (almost recovered). So increasing ef_search mitigates graph degradation at CPU cost.
jen: can we use a cheaper proxy than centroid to limit fallback rate? top2 ratio maybe
maria: tried top2_ratio < 0.62 as fallback rule: fallback rate 2.4% and recall@1 -> 0.856. Good tradeoff: less fallback, still recovers most quality.
arthur: rollout proposal: canary 5% traffic on a Dedicated pool for 24h, quant-int8 with top2-ratio fallback enabled. Monitor recall@1/5, latency_p95, and fallback_rate. If recall@1 down >1% sustained for 1h, rollback.
kai: add cluster purity and silhouette(k=60) to dashboard metrics. alert if fallback_rate increases >3x baseline in 30m.
jen: i'll own dashboard alerts and wiring to product metrics
arthur: i'll own canary script + HNSW ef tuning automation
maria: i'll prep staging run and docs. planned steps: deploy to staging tomorrow, run full eval harness, then canary on dedicated the next day if clean.
maria: eval command used:
```
python eval/embeddings_onboard.py --model compact-embed-v3-lite --quant int8 --dataset multilingual-eval --kmeans-k 60 --hnsw-ef 64 --seed 42 --batch-size 64 --out results/ce_v3lite_int8_k60.json
```
eval-bot: Artifacts uploaded: results/ce_v3lite_int8_k60.json (link) and sample-fail-cases.json (link)
maria: noted. I'll write a short summary doc with recommended defaults (top2 fallback threshold, ef_search default bump, and cost delta) after the staging run. :thumbsup:
jen: great, thanks for the clear runbook :sparkles:
